t: The Spectrum Drinking Water Inline Taste System provides filtered water directly at the point of use, ideal for homes and small installations such as offices or workshops. This compact inline water filter system effectively reduces chlorine, unpleasant tastes, and odours, ensuring cleaner drinking water. Phosphate within the system inhibits scale formation, contributing to a longer-lasting unit and appliances. Supplied as a complete kit, it includes a mini tap, saddle valve, mounting clips, connectors, and tubing, allowing for quick and straightforward installation without needing additional parts.
